name: Aurora Feathered Spire
description: A towering spire woven from iridescent feathers that ripple with the colors of the aurora borealis.
prompt: A slender, spiraling spire reaching into a star‑filled sky, constructed entirely from overlapping feathers that shift through greens, purples, and blues like the northern lights. The feathers gently move as if breathing. Ground is a frozen tundra with subtle ice crystals. Photorealistic, dynamic lighting, sense of motion, 8K resolution.
caption: Feathers that wear the sky’s own palette 🌌🪶 #AuroraSpire
